fact: The 1849 Catálogo alfabético de apellidos (open transcription) contains, on reprint page 87 among the Moñ- names, an entry read as "monasque"/"moñasque" between "monasca" and "moñascas". If the scan confirms "Moñasque", the family surname is very probably a Claveria-catalogue name adopted in 1850 and respelled with u (Visayan o/u interchange). Umpad, Ynot, Pino and Valiente are also catalogue names; Cosip, Gusat, Salimbangon and Patalinghug are not.
